evidence.name: Screen field: Terms link styling
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Terms link styling" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Terms link styling
sections.description: Sets the font, size, weight, color, and alignment of the Terms of Use link. Keep it consistent with the Restore and Privacy links beside it — small and muted is fine, but it must stay readable. Burying required legal links in unreadable micro-text invites store rejection and ad-network flags.
